wiki.title: Teresa Leger Fernández
wiki.extract: Teresa Isabel Leger Fernández ( LEJ-ər fər-NAN-dez; born July 1, 1959) is an American attorney and politician representing New Mexico's 3rd congressional district in the United States House of Representatives since 2021.
